title: Anheuser-Busch’s Kona Big Wave Continues Riding its Growth Wave in 2026
summary: Kona Big Wave has grown market share of beer in bars and restaurants for 45 consecutive months
body_markdown:
###


**St. Louis, MO – September 22, 2026** – Kona Big Wave, the easy-drinking beer originally born in and inspired by the legendary waves of Hawaii, continues its sales momentum in 2026, posting strong numbers nationwide.


Through Q2 of 2026, Kona Big Wave has grown market share of beer in bars and restaurants for


**45 consecutive months** ,


*1* consistently ranking as a


**Top 10 tap handle in the U.S.** *2* **** Overall, Kona Big Wave has nearly


**doubled its market share of beer across the country in less than five years** .


*3*


**Andy Thomas, President, The High End at Anheuser-Busch** said: “Anheuser-Busch's momentum is driven by a consumer-first strategy that is rooted in focus and consistency, connecting beer drinkers with our brands across a range of occasions. Kona Big Wave’s growth as a premium lifestyle beer is a clear indication that our strategy is resonating with consumers across the U.S.”


Coming off a hot summer season, Kona Big Wave has shown up across the country to authentically connect within its key lifestyle spaces of music, skate and surf. At music festivals like Welcome To Rockville, Oceans Calling and Lollapalooza, where Big Wave was one of the top beers sold at each, to board sports partnerships with SLS, Lib Tech and Paddle North — including a headlining sponsorship of


[STAB’s E.A.S.T Festival](https://www.anheuser-busch.com/newsroom/kona-big-wave-e-a-s-t-festival-brings-surf-culture-and-the-leaders-shaping-its-future-to-nyc-this-fall) next month — and, most importantly, continuing to shine at bars with new wave-inspired glassware, Kona Big Wave will continue to bring the Aloha spirit to beer drinkers year-round.


**About Kona Big Wave**


Founded under the golden sun of the Big Island of Hawaii in 1994, Kona Big Wave embraces the Aloha spirit while spreading its foundations of vitality, authenticity and building community. Today, the easy-drinking, island-style refreshing beer brings the taste of Aloha across the mainland U.S. and more than 30 countries globally. For more information visit konabigwave.com, and follow @KonaBigWave on Instagram, Facebook and X.


**About Anheuser-Busch**


At Anheuser-Busch, our purpose is to create a future with more cheers. For more than 165 years as a leading American manufacturer, we have delivered a legacy of brewing great-tasting, high-quality beers that have satisfied beer drinkers for generations. As the nation’s top brewer, one of the fastest growing spirits companies, and an emerging force in energy drinks, we drive economic prosperity nationwide through investments in our people, facilities, and communities. We are the only alcohol company that invests in the U.S. at this scale.


We make the nation’s most iconic beers, ready-to-drink spirits and beyond beer brands, including Michelob ULTRA – America’s #1 top-selling and fastest-growing beer – Busch Light, Budweiser, Bud Light, Stella Artois, Cutwater Spirits, NÜTRL Vodka Seltzer, BeatBox, industry-leading craft beers and non-alcohol beers like Michelob ULTRA Zero. We are guided by our commitment to the communities we call home and to the 65,000 hardworking Americans who bring our products to life. That’s who we are. For more information, visit
